ko.L: 사람은 자기 자신을 살펴보고, 그렇게 한 다음에 빵을 먹고 잔을 마셔야 합니다.
ko.B: 각 사람은 먼저 자기 자신을 살펴보고, 그런 다음에 빵을 먹고 잔을 마셔야 합니다.
ko.R: 그러니 빵을 먹고 잔을 마시기 전에 여러분 자신의 삶을 잘 살펴보십시오.

pt.L: Mas {{gender:cada pessoa examine a si mesma|o homem examine a si mesmo}}, e assim coma do pão e beba do cálice;
pt.B: Cada um de vocês deve primeiro examinar a si mesmo, e então comer do pão e beber do cálice.
pt.R: Por isso, olhem com cuidado para a própria vida antes de comerem o pão e beberem do cálice.

am.L: ሰው ግን ራሱን ይመርምር፤ እንዲሁም ከዳቦው ይብላ፣ ከጽዋውም ይጠጣ፤
am.B: እያንዳንዳችሁ አስቀድማችሁ ራሳችሁን መርምሩ፤ ከዚያም ከዳቦው ብሉ፣ ከጽዋውም ጠጡ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ዳቦውን ከመብላታችሁና ከጽዋው ከመጠጣታችሁ በፊት የራሳችሁን ሕይወት በጥንቃቄ ተመልከቱ።

decisions.choice: examine: test oneself, looking honestly at how one is treating the Lord and his people
decisions.reason: δοκιμαζέτω is to test and prove, the verb behind "the approved" of verse 19. The test is above all about the way they eat together (verses 20-22, 29).

decisions.choice: a person: any member of the church, man or woman
decisions.reason: ἄνθρωπος is used here of a human being in general, not of a man as opposed to a woman.

decisions.choice: Each of you should first examine yourself (B); look closely at your own life (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak to the reader directly, as Paul does in verses 26 and 33, and so avoid the stiff third-person command. The command applies to everyone (m2).

decisions.choice: "que {{gender:chacun|l’homme}} s’examine lui-même, et qu’ainsi il mange", with the span on the noun only (also verses 29 and 34)
alternatives: {{gender:que la personne s’examine elle-même|que l’homme s’examine lui-même}}
decisions.reason: The English needs spans on "themselves" and "them" as well as on "person". French puts the setting on the noun it has to choose for the Greek "man" (m2), with "chacun" as the inclusive default, and the "il" and "lui-même" that refer back to it are ordinary generic French with no span. For the same reason "celui qui ... lui-même" in verse 29 and "quelqu’un ... qu’il mange" in verse 34 take none.

decisions.choice: {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}; a sí mismo, no span
decisions.reason: Spanish follows the English setting for the noun, as in 2:11. Both options are masculine words, so "a sí mismo" and the verbs agree with either and need no span; Balanced and Readable say "cada uno", which covers everyone.

decisions.choice: mtu ajichunguze mwenyewe: no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: "Mtu", the reflexive "ji-" and "mwenyewe" already mean he or she, so the gender spans of verses 28-29 and 34 have nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "mỗi người", "mình", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người" and "mình" are already man or woman.

decisions.choice: {{gender:cada pessoa examine a si mesma|o homem examine a si mesmo}}
alternatives: {{gender:a pessoa|o homem}} examine a si mesmo
decisions.reason: The reflexive must agree with the noun, so the whole phrase goes under the setting (style §7). Balanced's "cada um de vocês" is already inclusive and needs no setting.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "ሰው ... ራሱን"
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: "ሰው" means any person, and the generic masculine suffix of "ራሱን" includes women, so Amharic has only one way of saying it and the English gender spans in verses 28, 29 and 34 have nothing to change. Balanced and Readable speak to "you" (plural) here.

source.text: ὁ γὰρ ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων κρίμα ἑαυτῷ ἐσθίει καὶ πίνει μὴ διακρίνων τὸ σῶμα.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] for eating and drinking judgment on himself eats and drinks not discerning the body.

en.L: For the one who eats and drinks eats and drinks judgment on {{gender:themselves|himself}}, not discerning the body.
en.B: Anyone who eats and drinks brings judgment on {{gender:themselves|himself}} by that eating and drinking, if {{gender:they do|he does}} not discern the body.
en.R: If you eat and drink without recognizing the Lord's body, you bring judgment on yourself as you eat and drink.

fr.L: Car celui qui mange et boit mange et boit un jugement contre lui-même, ne discernant pas le corps.
fr.B: Quiconque mange et boit sans discerner le corps attire sur lui-même un jugement par ce qu’il mange et boit.
fr.R: Si vous mangez et buvez sans reconnaître le corps du Seigneur, vous attirez sur vous un jugement en mangeant et en buvant.

es.L: Porque el que come y bebe, come y bebe juicio sobre sí mismo, no discerniendo el cuerpo.
es.B: Quien come y bebe sin discernir el cuerpo, trae juicio sobre sí mismo al comer y beber.
es.R: Quien come y bebe sin reconocer el cuerpo del Señor, trae juicio sobre sí mismo al comer y beber.

sw.L: Kwa maana yeye alaye na kunywa, hula na kunywa hukumu juu yake mwenyewe, asipoupambanua mwili.
sw.B: Yeyote anayekula na kunywa bila kuupambanua mwili, anajiletea hukumu kwa kula na kunywa huko.
sw.R: Mkila na kunywa bila kuutambua mwili wa Bwana, mnajiletea hukumu mnapokula na kunywa.

vi.L: Vì người ăn và uống mà không phân biệt thân thể thì ăn và uống sự phán xét cho chính mình.
vi.B: Ai ăn và uống mà không phân biệt thân thể, thì qua việc ăn uống ấy, người ấy chuốc lấy sự phán xét cho chính mình.
vi.R: Nếu anh chị em ăn và uống mà không nhận biết thân thể của Chúa, anh chị em đang chuốc lấy sự phán xét cho mình khi ăn uống.

ko.L: 몸을 분별하지 않고 먹고 마시는 사람은 자기에게 심판을 먹고 마시는 것입니다.
ko.B: 몸을 분별하지 않고 먹고 마시는 사람은, 그렇게 먹고 마셔서 자기에게 심판을 불러들이는 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님의 몸을 알아보지 못하고 먹고 마시면, 여러분은 먹고 마시면서 자기에게 심판을 불러오는 것입니다.

pt.L: Pois quem come e bebe come e bebe juízo para si, não discernindo o corpo.
pt.B: Quem come e bebe sem discernir o corpo traz juízo sobre si por esse comer e beber.
pt.R: Se vocês comem e bebem sem reconhecer o corpo do Senhor, trazem juízo sobre vocês mesmos enquanto comem e bebem.

am.L: የሚበላና የሚጠጣ፣ ሥጋውን ሳይለይ በራሱ ላይ ፍርድን ይበላልና፣ ይጠጣልምና።
am.B: ሥጋውን ሳይለይ የሚበላና የሚጠጣ ሁሉ በዚህ በመብላቱና በመጠጣቱ በራሱ ላይ ፍርድን ያመጣል።
am.R: የጌታን ሥጋ ሳታስተውሉ ብትበሉና ብትጠጡ፣ በመብላታችሁና በመጠጣታችሁ በራሳችሁ ላይ ፍርድ ታመጣላችሁ።

decisions.choice: discerning the body: recognizing the Lord's body given for them, and with it the church that his body makes one
alternatives: recognizing that the bread is the Lord's body, as distinct from ordinary food
recognizing the church as the body of Christ, and treating its members rightly
decisions.reason: διακρίνων means to judge rightly, to tell apart. Paul says only "the body", not "the body and the blood" as in verse 27. In 10:16-17 the bread is a sharing in the body of Christ, and because there is one bread, "we who are many are one body"; chapter 12 goes on to call the church the body of Christ. Since the wrong in Corinth is despising poorer believers at the meal, many read "the body" as the church; others as the Lord's body in the bread. The two are closely joined in Paul's thought, and he may mean both.

decisions.choice: follow the SBLGNT: "eats and drinks" and "the body", without additions
alternatives: "eats and drinks unworthily ... not discerning the body of the Lord"
decisions.reason: The earliest manuscripts have the shorter text. Many later manuscripts add ἀναξίως ("unworthily") after "drinks", from verse 27, and "of the Lord" after "the body". Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: judgment: God's judgment on them, which verses 30-32 describe as discipline, not final condemnation
decisions.reason: κρίμα is a verdict or judgment. Verse 32 sets it apart from being "condemned along with the world": it is the Lord's correction of his people.

decisions.choice: a play on words: the verbs for judging and discerning run through verses 29-32
decisions.reason: διακρίνων ("discern") and κρίμα ("judgment") are taken up in verse 31 ("discern ourselves", "be judged") and verse 32 ("judged", "condemned"), all from the same root. Those who judge rightly now will not need to be judged.

decisions.choice: the Lord's body
decisions.reason: Readable adds "the Lord's", which is true on each reading of m1, since the church is also the Lord's body. It does not decide between them.

decisions.choice: discernir; juicio, juzgados (verses 29-32)
decisions.reason: The verbs for judging and discerning run through verses 29-32 (m4). Literal and Balanced keep "discernir" for one and "juicio" and "juzgar" for the other so the play can be followed. "Sí mismo" is the ordinary form for anyone, so the English gender spans have no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: kupambanua; hukumu, kuhukumiwa
decisions.reason: "Kupambanua" (discern) here and in verse 31, and "hukumu / kuhukumiwa" in verses 29-32, so the play on judging and discerning stays visible; Readable says "kutambua" (recognise).

decisions.choice: "phân biệt" for diakrino (11:29, 11:31) and "phán xét", "xét đoán" for krino (11:29-32)
decisions.reason: Paul plays on the verbs of judging (m4); Vietnamese cannot keep one root for them all, but each verb is kept the same through the verses, so the reader can follow them. What "the body" means is open (m1), and Literal and Balanced do not settle it.

decisions.choice: "분별하다" (L, B), "알아보다" (R) for discerning; "심판" for the judgment, through verses 29-34
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "the body" as the Lord's body given for them and the church it makes one; Literal and Balanced keep the Greek's bare "the body". "분별하다" returns in verse 31, so the play on words can be seen.

decisions.choice: quem ... para si / sobre si, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting for "themselves/himself". Portuguese "quem" already means anyone, and "si" does not mark gender, so no setting is needed (style §7). Readable speaks to "vocês", as the English Readable says "you".

decisions.choice: "ሥጋውን ሳይለይ" (not discerning the body)
alternatives: "አካሉን" (the body, as of the church in chapter 12)
decisions.reason: "ሥጋ" ties the verse to the Lord's body given at the meal (verses 24, 27), which the meaning decision puts first; the church that his body makes one is in view through that link. "ለየ" (discern, distinguish) keeps the play with "ፍርድ" and "ፈረደ" through verses 29-32 partly visible.

source.text: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν πολλοὶ ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ἄρρωστοι καὶ κοιμῶνται ἱκανοί.

records.literal_gloss: Because of this among you many weak and sick, and are sleeping a good number.

en.L: Because of this many among you [are] weak and sick, and a good number are sleeping.
en.B: This is the reason so many among you are weak and ill, and a good number have died.
en.R: Because of this, a lot of you are weak and sick, and quite a few have died.

fr.L: C’est pour cela que beaucoup parmi vous [sont] faibles et malades, et qu’un bon nombre dorment.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi tant de gens parmi vous sont faibles et malades, et un bon nombre sont morts.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que beaucoup d’entre vous sont faibles et malades, et qu’un certain nombre sont morts.

es.L: Por esto hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} muchos débiles y enfermos, y bastantes duermen.
es.B: Por esta razón hay entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tantos débiles y enfermos, y bastantes han muerto.
es.R: Por eso muchos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} están débiles y enfermos, y unos cuantos han muerto.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii wengi kati yenu [ni] dhaifu na wagonjwa, na wengi kiasi wanalala.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo sababu wengi kati yenu ni dhaifu na wagonjwa, na idadi kubwa wamekufa.
sw.R: Kwa sababu hiyo, wengi wenu ni dhaifu na wagonjwa, na si wachache wamekufa.

vi.L: Vì điều này mà giữa anh chị em có nhiều người yếu đuối và bệnh tật, và không ít người đang ngủ.
vi.B: Đó là lý do mà giữa anh chị em có nhiều người yếu đuối và đau ốm, và không ít người đã qua đời.
vi.R: Vì điều này, nhiều người trong anh chị em yếu đuối và đau ốm, và khá nhiều người đã chết.

ko.L: 이 때문에 여러분 가운데 약한 사람과 병든 사람이 많고, 잠든 사람도 적지 않습니다.
ko.B: 이 때문에 여러분 가운데 몸이 약하고 병든 사람이 많고, 죽은 사람도 적지 않습니다.
ko.R: 이 때문에 여러분 가운데 많은 사람이 약하고 아프며, 적지 않은 사람이 죽었습니다.

pt.L: Por isso há entre vocês muitos fracos e doentes, e não poucos dormem.
pt.B: É por isso que há entre vocês tantos fracos e doentes, e não poucos morreram.
pt.R: Por causa disso, muitos de vocês estão fracos e doentes, e vários já morreram.

am.L: ስለዚህ በእናንተ መካከል ብዙዎች ደካሞችና ሕመምተኞች ናቸው፤ ጥቂት የማይባሉትም አንቀላፍተዋል።
am.B: ከእናንተ መካከል ብዙዎቹ የደከሙትና የታመሙት፣ ጥቂት የማይባሉትም የሞቱት በዚህ ምክንያት ነው።
am.R: በዚህ ምክንያት ብዙዎቻችሁ ደክማችኋል፤ ታማችኋልም። ጥቂት የማይባሉትም ሞተዋል።

decisions.choice: sleeping: dying, a gentle way of speaking of death for those who belong to Christ
decisions.reason: κοιμάομαι, "fall asleep", is used of believers who have died (7:39; 15:6, 15:18, 15:20; 1 Thessalonians 4:13-15). It looks forward to waking at the resurrection. The present tense means that deaths are still happening.

decisions.choice: because of this: Paul links these illnesses and deaths to the way they have treated the Lord's meal
decisions.reason: Paul gives this as the Lord's discipline (verse 32) in this one case. He does not say that every illness comes from sin; elsewhere he speaks of his own weakness as no sign of God's anger (2 Corinthians 12:7-10).

decisions.choice: have died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m1), as at 7:39; Literal keeps "sleeping".

decisions.choice: duermen (L); han muerto (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:39: Literal keeps the Greek picture of sleep for death (m1), and Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: wanalala (L); wamekufa (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 7:39: Literal keeps the image of sleep for death, Balanced and Readable say plainly that they have died.

decisions.choice: dormem
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "dormir" for the gentle way of speaking of a believer's death (m1); the present tense says the deaths are still happening. Balanced and Readable say "morreram", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "አንቀላፍተዋል" (have fallen asleep) (L); "ሞተዋል" (have died) (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of sleep for death; Balanced and Readable say plainly that they died, as the English does.

source.text: εἰ δὲ ἑαυτοὺς διεκρίνομεν, οὐκ ἂν ἐκρινόμεθα·

records.literal_gloss: If but ourselves we were discerning, not would we be judged;

en.L: But if we were discerning ourselves, we would not be judged;
en.B: If we examined ourselves with discernment, we would not be coming under judgment.
en.R: If we would look carefully at ourselves, the Lord would not need to judge us.

fr.L: Mais si nous nous discernions nous-mêmes, nous ne serions pas jugés ;
fr.B: Si nous nous examinions nous-mêmes avec discernement, nous ne tomberions pas sous le jugement.
fr.R: Si nous regardions attentivement notre propre vie, le Seigneur n’aurait pas besoin de nous juger.

es.L: Pero si nos discerniéramos a nosotros mismos, no seríamos juzgados;
es.B: Si nos examináramos a nosotros mismos con discernimiento, no caeríamos bajo juicio.
es.R: Si nos examináramos bien a nosotros mismos, el Señor no necesitaría juzgarnos.

sw.L: Lakini kama tungejipambanua wenyewe, tusingehukumiwa;
sw.B: Kama tungejichunguza na kujipambanua wenyewe ipasavyo, tusingekuwa tukiingia hukumuni.
sw.R: Kama tungejiangalia wenyewe kwa makini, Bwana asingehitaji kutuhukumu.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu chúng ta tự phân biệt mình, thì chúng ta đã không bị phán xét;
vi.B: Nếu chúng ta tự xét mình cách sáng suốt, thì chúng ta đã không bị phán xét.
vi.R: Nếu chúng ta chịu xem xét kỹ chính mình, thì Chúa đã không cần phải phán xét chúng ta.

ko.L: 우리가 우리 자신을 분별했다면 심판을 받지 않았을 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 우리 자신을 바르게 분별했다면 심판을 받지 않았을 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리가 우리 자신을 잘 살펴보았다면, 주님께서 우리를 심판하실 필요가 없었을 것입니다.

pt.L: Mas, se discerníssemos a nós mesmos, não seríamos julgados;
pt.B: Se nos examinássemos com discernimento, não estaríamos sendo julgados.
pt.R: Se nós olhássemos com cuidado para nós mesmos, o Senhor não precisaria nos julgar.

am.L: ራሳችንን ብንለይ ኖሮ ግን ባልተፈረደብንም ነበር፤
am.B: ራሳችንን በማስተዋል ብንመረምር ኖሮ ፍርድ ባልመጣብን ነበር።
am.R: ራሳችንን በጥንቃቄ ብንመለከት ኖሮ ጌታ ሊፈርድብን ባላስፈለገው ነበር።

decisions.choice: if we were discerning ourselves: a condition contrary to fact; they have not been doing so
decisions.reason: διεκρίνομεν and ἐκρινόμεθα with ἂν describe what is not the case: because they have not judged themselves rightly, the Lord is judging them.

decisions.choice: discern ourselves: judge our own conduct rightly
decisions.reason: διεκρίνομεν is the verb of verse 29 ("discerning the body"); judging oneself rightly includes recognizing the body.

decisions.choice: the Lord would not need to judge us
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who judges, as verse 32 does.

source.text: κρινόμενοι δὲ ὑπὸ κυρίου παιδευόμεθα, ἵνα μὴ σὺν τῷ κόσμῳ κατακριθῶμεν.

records.literal_gloss: Being judged but by [the] Lord we are disciplined, so that not with the world we may be condemned.

en.L: But being judged by [the] Lord, we are disciplined, so that we may not be condemned with the world.
en.B: But when the Lord judges us, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is correcting us, to keep us from being condemned along with the world.
en.R: But when the Lord judges us, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is correcting us like a parent, so that we will not end up condemned with the rest of the world.

fr.L: Mais étant jugés par le Seigneur, nous sommes corrigés, afin que nous ne soyons pas condamnés avec le monde.
fr.B: Mais quand le Seigneur nous juge, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous corrige, pour que nous ne soyons pas condamnés avec le monde.
fr.R: Mais quand le Seigneur nous juge, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous corrige comme un père ou une mère corrige son enfant. Ainsi, nous ne serons pas condamnés avec le reste du monde.

es.L: Pero siendo juzgados por [el] Señor, somos disciplinados, para que no seamos condenados con el mundo.
es.B: Pero cuando el Señor nos juzga, nos está corrigiendo, para que no seamos condenados junto con el mundo.
es.R: Pero cuando el Señor nos juzga, nos está corrigiendo como un padre, para que no terminemos condenados con el resto del mundo.

sw.L: Lakini tukihukumiwa na Bwana, tunarudiwa, ili tusihukumiwe adhabu pamoja na ulimwengu.
sw.B: Lakini Bwana anapotuhukumu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anaturudi, ili tusije tukahukumiwa adhabu pamoja na ulimwengu.
sw.R: Lakini Bwana anapotuhukumu, anaturudi kama mzazi, ili tusije tukaishia kuhukumiwa adhabu pamoja na watu wengine wa ulimwengu.

vi.L: Nhưng khi bị Chúa phán xét, chúng ta được sửa phạt, để chúng ta không bị kết án cùng với thế gian.
vi.B: Nhưng khi Chúa phán xét chúng ta, là {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang sửa dạy chúng ta, để chúng ta khỏi bị kết án cùng với thế gian.
vi.R: Nhưng khi Chúa phán xét chúng ta, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang sửa dạy chúng ta như cha mẹ sửa dạy con, để rốt cuộc chúng ta không bị kết án cùng với thế gian.

ko.L: 그러나 우리가 주님께 심판을 받는 것은 징계를 받는 것이니, 우리가 세상과 함께 정죄를 받지 않게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 주님께서 우리를 심판하실 때에는 우리를 바로잡아 주시는 것입니다. 우리가 세상과 함께 정죄를 받지 않게 하시려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주님께서 우리를 심판하실 때에는, 부모가 자녀를 바로잡듯이 우리를 바로잡아 주시는 것입니다. 그래서 우리가 나머지 세상 사람들과 함께 정죄를 받지 않게 하십니다.

pt.L: Mas, sendo julgados pelo Senhor, somos disciplinados, para que não sejamos condenados com o mundo.
pt.B: Mas, quando o Senhor nos julga, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está nos corrigindo, para que não sejamos condenados junto com o mundo.
pt.R: Mas, quando o Senhor nos julga, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está nos corrigindo como um pai corrige um filho, para que não acabemos condenados com o resto do mundo.

am.L: በጌታ ሲፈረድብን ግን እንገሠጻለን፤ [ይህም] ከዓለም ጋር እንዳንኮነን ነው።
am.B: ጌታ ሲፈርድብን ግን ከዓለም ጋር እንዳንኮነን እየገሠጸን ነው።
am.R: ነገር ግን ጌታ ሲፈርድብን ወላጅ ልጁን እንደሚያርም እያረመን ነው፤ ይህም ከተቀረው ዓለም ጋር እንዳንኮነን ነው።

decisions.choice: disciplined: corrected and trained, as a father corrects a child
decisions.reason: παιδευόμεθα belongs to the language of bringing up children. The Lord disciplines those he loves as a father does his son (Proverbs 3:11-12; Hebrews 12:5-11).

decisions.choice: the Lord: the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Throughout verses 23-32 "the Lord" is Jesus, whose meal it is and whose body and blood are dishonored.

decisions.choice: the world: humanity set against God, which will be condemned
decisions.reason: κόσμῳ here is the world that does not know God (1:21; 6:2). The discipline keeps believers from sharing its final condemnation.

decisions.choice: like a parent
decisions.reason: Readable brings out the picture behind the verb (m1).

decisions.choice: comme un père ou une mère corrige son enfant
decisions.reason: French "un parent" in the singular usually means a relative, not a father or mother, so Readable names both to bring out the picture of the English "like a parent" (m1).

decisions.choice: nos está corrigiendo, no pronoun
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject in the verb, so the English "he" has no Spanish word and no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: kurudi (to correct)
decisions.reason: "Kurudi" is the word for a parent correcting and training a child, the sense of the meaning decision; "kuadhibu" (punish) would lose the purpose of correction.

decisions.choice: como um pai corrige um filho
alternatives: como um pai ou uma mãe
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "like a parent"; Portuguese has no everyday singular word for a parent without gender, and "pais" would be heard as "fathers". Readable follows the picture behind the verb, a father correcting a son (m1; Proverbs 3:11-12).

decisions.choice: "እንገሠጻለን" (we are disciplined)
decisions.reason: "መገሠጽ" is the correcting of a child or pupil (m1), not punishment; Readable says "ወላጅ ልጁን እንደሚያርም" (as a parent corrects a child).

source.text: Ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου, συνερχόμενοι εἰς τὸ φαγεῖν ἀλλήλους ἐκδέχεσθε.

records.literal_gloss: So that, brothers of me, coming together for the to eat one another wait for.

en.L: Therefore, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, coming together for eating, wait for one another.
en.B: So, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, when you meet for the meal, wait for each other.
en.R: So, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, when you meet to eat together, wait for each other.

fr.L: Ainsi, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, en vous réunissant pour manger, attendez-vous les uns les autres.
fr.B: Ainsi, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, quand vous vous réunissez pour le repas, attendez-vous les uns les autres.
fr.R: Donc, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, quand vous vous réunissez pour manger ensemble, attendez-vous les uns les autres.

es.L: Así que, hermanos míos, cuando {{plural_you:se reúnan|os reunáis}} para comer, {{plural_you:espérense|esperaos}} unos a otros.
es.B: Así que, hermanos míos, cuando {{plural_you:se reúnan|os reunáis}} para la comida, {{plural_you:espérense|esperaos}} unos a otros.
es.R: Así que, hermanos míos, cuando {{plural_you:se reúnan|os reunáis}} para comer juntos, {{plural_you:espérense|esperaos}} unos a otros.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, mnapokutana kwa ajili ya kula, ngojaneni.
sw.B: Basi, ndugu zangu, mnapokutana kwa ajili ya chakula, ngojaneni.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, mnapokutana kula pamoja, ngojaneni.

vi.L: Vì vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, khi nhóm họp để ăn, hãy chờ đợi nhau.
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, khi nhóm họp để dự bữa ăn, hãy chờ nhau.
vi.R: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, khi nhóm họp để cùng ăn, hãy chờ nhau.

ko.L: 그러므로 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 먹으려고 모일 때에는 서로 기다리십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 식사하려고 모일 때에는 서로 기다리십시오.
ko.R: 그러니 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 함께 먹으려고 모일 때에는 서로 기다려 주십시오.

pt.L: Portanto, meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, quando se reúnem para comer, esperem uns pelos outros.
pt.B: Assim, meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, quando vocês se reunirem para a refeição, esperem uns pelos outros.
pt.R: Por isso, meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, quando vocês se reunirem para comer juntos, esperem uns pelos outros.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞቼና እኅቶቼ|ወንድሞቼ}} ሆይ፣ ለመብላት ስትሰበሰቡ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተጠባበቁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞቼና እኅቶቼ|ወንድሞቼ}} ሆይ፣ ለማዕዱ ስትሰበሰቡ አንዳችሁ ሌላውን ጠብቁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞቼና እኅቶቼ|ወንድሞቼ}} ሆይ፣ አብራችሁ ለመብላት ስትሰበሰቡ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተጠባበቁ።

decisions.choice: wait for one another: do not start eating until all are there
alternatives: welcome one another, receive one another as guests
decisions.reason: ἐκδέχεσθε usually means to wait for or expect (16:11). It answers the problem of verse 21, where some go ahead with their meal. Some read it as "welcome", which would also suit the shame done to the poor; both lead to sharing the meal together.

decisions.choice: so then: the conclusion of the whole section, verses 17-32
decisions.reason: Ὥστε draws the practical conclusion from the warnings of verses 27-32.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers (for chapters 11-13)
decisions.reason: As in English and in Colossians, Paul addresses the church, men and women together; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

source.text: εἴ τις πεινᾷ, ἐν οἴκῳ ἐσθιέτω, ἵνα μὴ εἰς κρίμα συνέρχησθε.

records.literal_gloss: If anyone is hungry, at home let him eat, so that not for judgment you come together.

en.L: If anyone is hungry, let {{gender:them|him}} eat at home, so that you do not come together for judgment.
en.B: If someone is hungry, let {{gender:them|him}} eat at home, so that your coming together does not lead to judgment.
en.R: If you are hungry, eat at home first. Then your meetings will not bring judgment on you.

fr.L: Si quelqu’un a faim, qu’il mange à la maison, afin que vous ne vous réunissiez pas pour un jugement.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un a faim, qu’il mange chez lui, afin que vos réunions n’attirent pas sur vous un jugement.
fr.R: Si vous avez faim, mangez d’abord chez vous. Alors vos réunions n’attireront pas de jugement sur vous.

es.L: Si alguno tiene hambre, que coma en casa, para que no {{plural_you:se reúnan|os reunáis}} para juicio.
es.B: Si alguien tiene hambre, que coma en casa, para que {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} reuniones no {{plural_you:les|os}} traigan juicio.
es.R: Si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} hambre, {{plural_you:coman|comed}} primero en casa. Así {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} reuniones no {{plural_you:les|os}} traerán juicio.

sw.L: Mtu yeyote akiwa na njaa, ale nyumbani, ili msikutane kwa ajili ya hukumu.
sw.B: Mtu akiwa na njaa, ale nyumbani kwake, ili kukutana kwenu kusilete hukumu.
sw.R: Kama mna njaa, kuleni nyumbani kwanza. Hapo mikutano yenu haitawaletea hukumu.

vi.L: Nếu ai đói, hãy ăn ở nhà, để anh chị em không nhóm họp mà chuốc lấy sự phán xét.
vi.B: Nếu ai đói, hãy ăn ở nhà, để việc nhóm họp của anh chị em không đưa đến sự phán xét.
vi.R: Nếu anh chị em đói, hãy ăn ở nhà trước. Như vậy, các buổi nhóm họp của anh chị em sẽ không đem sự phán xét đến cho anh chị em.

ko.L: 누구든지 배가 고프면 집에서 먹으십시오. 여러분이 모여서 심판을 받지 않게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 누구든지 배가 고프면 집에서 먹으십시오. 그래서 여러분이 모이는 것이 심판을 불러오지 않게 하십시오.
ko.R: 배가 고프면 먼저 집에서 먹으십시오. 그러면 여러분의 모임이 심판을 불러오지 않을 것입니다.

pt.L: Se alguém tem fome, coma em casa, para que vocês não se reúnam para juízo.
pt.B: Se alguém está com fome, coma em casa, para que as reuniões de vocês não resultem em juízo.
pt.R: Se vocês estiverem com fome, comam antes em casa. Assim, as reuniões de vocês não vão trazer juízo sobre vocês.

am.L: ማንም ቢራብ በቤቱ ይብላ፤ ለፍርድ እንዳትሰበሰቡ።
am.B: የተራበ ሰው ቢኖር መሰብሰባችሁ ፍርድ እንዳያመጣባችሁ በቤቱ ይብላ።
am.R: ከተራባችሁ አስቀድማችሁ በቤታችሁ ብሉ። ያን ጊዜ ስብሰባችሁ ፍርድ አያመጣባችሁም።

decisions.choice: eat at home: satisfy one's hunger at home, so that the church's meal is not a scramble to eat
alternatives: do not eat at church at all
decisions.reason: Paul does not end the shared meal; he has just told them to wait for one another when they come together to eat (verse 33). Those who cannot wait should eat first at home, so that the meal in church is shared fairly.

decisions.choice: judgment: the Lord's judgment of verses 29-32
decisions.reason: κρίμα is the same word as in verse 29.

decisions.choice: eat at home first
decisions.reason: Readable adds "first" to show that Paul is not cancelling the shared meal (m1).

decisions.choice: If you are hungry
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to the reader directly, which avoids a gendered pronoun.

decisions.choice: que coma, no gender span
decisions.reason: The Spanish verb does not show whether "anyone" is a man or a woman, as in 3:14, so the English gender spans have nothing to change.

decisions.choice: Se alguém tem fome, coma, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting for "them/him". Portuguese leaves the subject of "coma" unspoken after "alguém", so no pronoun and no setting is needed.

source.text: Τὰ δὲ λοιπὰ ὡς ἂν ἔλθω διατάξομαι.

records.literal_gloss: The but remaining things whenever I come I will set in order.

en.L: And the remaining things I will set in order whenever I come.
en.B: The remaining matters I will set right when I come.
en.R: I will take care of the other matters when I visit you.

fr.L: Quant au reste, je [le] réglerai quand je viendrai.
fr.B: Les autres questions, je les réglerai quand je viendrai.
fr.R: Je m’occuperai des autres questions quand je viendrai vous voir.

es.L: Y las demás cosas las pondré en orden cuando vaya.
es.B: Los demás asuntos los arreglaré cuando vaya.
es.R: Me ocuparé de los otros asuntos cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} visite.

sw.L: Na mambo yaliyobaki nitayapanga nitakapokuja.
sw.B: Mambo mengine yaliyobaki nitayaweka sawa nitakapokuja.
sw.R: Nitashughulikia mambo mengine nitakapowatembelea.

vi.L: Còn những điều khác, khi nào tôi đến, tôi sẽ sắp đặt.
vi.B: Những vấn đề còn lại, tôi sẽ giải quyết khi đến.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ lo liệu những việc khác khi tôi đến thăm anh chị em.

ko.L: 나머지 일들은 내가 갈 때에 바로잡겠습니다.
ko.B: 그 밖의 일들은 내가 가서 바로잡겠습니다.
ko.R: 다른 문제들은 내가 여러분을 찾아갈 때에 처리하겠습니다.

pt.L: E as demais coisas porei em ordem quando eu for.
pt.B: As outras questões eu resolverei quando chegar aí.
pt.R: Vou cuidar das outras questões quando visitar vocês.

am.L: የቀሩትን ነገሮች ግን በመጣሁ ጊዜ አስተካክላለሁ።
am.B: ሌሎቹን ጉዳዮች ስመጣ አስተካክላለሁ።
am.R: ልጠይቃችሁ ስመጣ ሌሎቹን ጉዳዮች አስተካክላለሁ።

decisions.choice: the remaining things: other questions about the meal or the gatherings, which Paul will settle in person
decisions.reason: διατάξομαι is to give orders, to arrange (7:17; 16:1). Paul plans to come to Corinth (4:19; 16:5) and leaves the rest until then.
